name: agent-studio
description: Run a session as an agent (/as) and watch agents and sessions in a panel

enableLauncher.title: Launcher
enableLauncher.description: Turns on the /as command, which makes the session act as an agent from .claude/agents

enableMonitor.title: Monitor
enableMonitor.description: Turns on the /agent-panel command, which shows this session's subagents and the other open sessions

shareAnswers.title: Share answers
shareAnswers.description: Publishes up to 300 characters of this session's last answer so other sessions can read it in /agent-panel sessions

modelAliases.title: Model aliases
modelAliases.description: Comma-separated alias=id pairs, used when an agent declares its model by alias, such as model: opus

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plugin's messages: en or pt-BR
